name: Alcollarín (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red above and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcollarín (a tree, bears and a wheel).
history: Municipal flag of Alcollarín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcollarín arms — tree, bears and wheel
